findings: Largest wins: BF16 per_layer_model_proj on NPU (+43%), NPU flash attention (+16%), pipelined prefill chunks (+10%), row-block dequant (+10%)
8-chunk PPL cannot gate W4A4 changes (chaotic: 1e-7 perturbation moves it +-3%); replaced with 32-chunk PPL + KLD vs CPU
RKNN driver converts non-native B at set_io_mem: data written to a bound B buffer is ignored (P*V zeros until re-bound)
Guard must exercise the changed path: first NPU-attention guard pass was invalid (perplexity batched 4 sequences, op rejected)
Remaining prefill limit: CPU dequant of NPU INT16 output (~31% of samples)

config.goal: improve E4B prefill speed using the NPU, including rewriting code for NPU
config.metric: llama-bench -p 512 -n 0 -r 3 -t 4 (taskset 4-7) t/s, E4B Q4_0 default W4A4
